Expense rules: API subscriptions: Cloud/R&D software rental categories supported; API charges not specifically named, so require classification/approval and project-use evidence.; clawback: Termination returns unspent/nonconforming subsidies plus interest; rescission can recover all paid subsidy plus interest, normally within 30 days. Serious breaches can bar grants 1–5 years.; computers: R&D computer/IT equipment monthly use cost C/36 × project use/months; other equipment C/60. Not full purchase cash reimbursement; administrative equipment excluded.; founder salary: Only genuine project R&D performed by company-hired personnel, apportioned with time/R&D records and payroll/payment proof; founder title alone is insufficient. Administrative/accounting/project-management work excluded.; other: Consumables, intangible assets, commissioned R&D, verification and patent application categories. Receipts, contracts, payment proof and approved changes required.; rent: No ordinary office/home rent category. Professional R&D software, cloud equipment and bandwidth rentals may qualify as approved apportioned equipment use.; reporting: Periodic work/financial reports, R&D logs, technical checks, final report and post-award outcome/promotional cooperation.; salary items: Base pay, role/professional allowances, overtime, tax-exempt meals and actually paid bonuses can qualify; employer pension/severance/labour-health insurance excluded.; travel: Domestic travel for listed R&D personnel; consultant/expert travel and fuel subsidies excluded. No foreign-travel approval established.
Requirements: MVP: Functional prototype at application; aim for productisation and commercial results.; deliverables: Year 1 product/prototype validation and at least one formal order; year 2 at least three formal orders in same target market; year-2 commercial outcomes normally ≥50% subsidy. Technical checkpoints at least every 6 months; outcome checkpoint every 12.; submission: Paper package to Taipei office plus electronic files to [email omitted].; video: No standalone video mandate found.

Breach may cause joint damages liability.; founder salary: Not a payroll reimbursement programme; vouchers cannot be represented as unrestricted cash salary.; rent: No additional reimbursement.; reporting clawback: No reward if agreed deliverables or required promotion not completed. Separate cooperation contract remains uninspected; confidentiality annex contains continuing duties and damages liability.; travel: No additional travel funding established.
Requirements: outputs: Working/test platform, repeated user tests, security fixes, public code and final report/slides. Standard for Public Code compliance and licences required.; proposal: Chinese editable Word/PPT/ODF with contents and page numbers. Problem analysis, solution/platform/location, roles, resources, delivery and impact. No application video or pre-existing MVP requirement found.

Expense rules: API subscriptions: Approved professional R&D software and cloud IaaS/PaaS/SaaS rental may qualify using project allocation or incremental cost, excluding setup/consultancy/one-off fees. API service is not automatically accepted, and prohibited-origin AI restrictions still apply.; IP clawback: Company generally retains results subject to governmental public-interest/research intervention rights. Misuse, false claims and breach can trigger recovery and 1–5-year disqualification; not unrestricted cash.; accounting: Invoices, payment proof, assets/cloud allocation and payroll/time records; final financial audit. Changes require approval.; computers: Allocated approved R&D equipment/software use; cannot assume full laptop purchase reimbursed.; founder salary: Eligible only for actual approved R&D employment/project time with payroll/time evidence; no founder living stipend.; other: Personnel, consumables, equipment use/maintenance, intangible technology/commissioned R&D/verification, domestic travel and innovation promotion categories. Technology/research group ≤40%; promotion ≤10%. Specified consumables/technology/research/verification/promotion subsidy share under 50%.; rent: General office/housing rent not an established expense head.; travel: Approved domestic R&D/project travel; not blanket international travel.
Requirements: application: Business-certificate-authenticated online submission, financial/declaration documents and mixed online/uploaded PDF proposal ≤20MB. Review deck required. No general application video requirement found.; security: Cybersecurity budget ≥7% total; security rating before contracting and at end; third-party app testing if app delivered. Prohibits PRC-origin AI models through API/MCP and specified PRC-brand ICT/software/cloud and data storage/transfers, including relevant Hong Kong/Macao restrictions.

Expense rules: Dedicated account, original vouchers, cost audit and interest/unspent return. Payroll 60% total-budget reference, future hires <=30% person-months; technology transfer 30% and outsourcing 60% published caps. No general office equipment/consumables or VAT. Software/equipment use and R&D IP can qualify; adviser travel excluded. Funded R&D results cannot be produced/used outside Taiwan for two years from creation; review can extend this restriction where overseas use would affect domestic competitiveness/research layout.
Requirements: Single-company application; no numeric personnel minimum identified. Formal employee research staffing with under-five-employee evidence alternative. No fixed mandatory MVP/video rule found. Foreign R&D staffing documentation is distinct from unverified founder nationality requirements.

tw-khh-local-sbir.activities:
Expense rules: API subscriptions: Not specifically resolved; must fit approved eligible software/equipment/technical category.; IP: Applicant owns or co-owns research. Government research licence and public-interest/non-use intervention rights; no overseas implementation before obligations complete without written approval.; accounting: Dedicated bank account and separate ledger, originals and monthly actual-cost withdrawals; interest and unused/ineligible funds returned. Midterm and final reports; final draft accounting/report within 10 days of end, revised within 15 days of approval, CPA certification.; clawback: Unused/non-project costs recovered; breach may terminate and demand refund/damages. Subsequent monitoring and records inspection apply.; computers: R&D equipment/software use allocation, not unrestricted full purchase. General office equipment excluded.; founder salary: Only genuine formal R&D staff project time; founder title alone insufficient. Eligible base/role/technical/manager allowances; overtime, bonuses, pensions, insurance and meals excluded. Personnel normally ≤60% budget, specified sectors 70%; excess justified. Management ≤4 person-months/year; new hires ≤30% R&D person-months.; other: Consumables normally ≤25%, no ordinary stationery; technical transfer/commissioned research ≤50%; advisors ≤TWD10,000/month; domestic patents ≤30,000 and foreign ≤100,000 under limits.; rent: No general office/housing rent expense head established.; travel: No standalone travel head established.
Requirements: application: Phase 1 A application and approximately 4-page B concept; invited phase 2 detailed C plan. Word files ≤25MB. Financial, employment and compliance evidence required. Expense rules: IP: Possible national ownership for national security, major marine/ecological impact, stipulated contract/notice or other OAC determination; no relocation of research to mainland China. Do not promise unconditional private ownership.; categories: Personnel, consumables, technology transfer/contract research, domestic travel and other operating expenses. Management<=10%. Project site, transport-vehicle and vessel rentals can qualify.; clawbacks: Nonexecution without valid reason can bring three-year exclusion; false declarations/breach can cancel and recover. Confidentiality breach can lead to ten-year ban. Contract includes representative joint-guarantee liability.; computers equipment: Capital expenditure excluded. Approved rental of project machinery/equipment allowed; do not budget full computer purchase.; founder salary: Eligible actual R&D staff payroll/effort subject to approved budget; founder status alone insufficient.; matching: Self contribution ordinarily below paid capital, or adequate financial plan.; office rent: Project-specific site rentals can fit other operating cost; ordinary standing office overhead is not thereby approved.; reporting: Quarterly at least two checkpoints, logs and financial evidence; audits and closeout.; subscriptions API: Software/service costs need approved classification; API subscriptions not expressly confirmed.; travel flights: Domestic project travel only in stated category; no overseas entitlement.
Requirements: novelty: Future project, not already ongoing/completed; marine policy relevance, innovation and feasible measurable results.; submission: OAC project portal account/login/captcha; public81-page manual contains application, accounting and contract annexes.; video: No application video requirement found.

Expense rules: IP: Research/IP belongs to applicant, but results generally may not be produced/used outside Taiwan jurisdiction for two years from generation without the prescribed approval exception.; categories: R&D personnel, materials, equipment use/maintenance, technology transfer and contract research, qualified patent application expenses.; clawbacks: Unused funds/interest returned; false or duplicate grant/noncompliance may terminate and recover full grant plus interest.; computers equipment: Approved equipment usage/depreciation and maintenance; caps and property-list evidence; operational rental can fall under outsourcing. Not blanket computer purchase.; founder salary: Formal eligible R&D payroll and effort; personnel normally<=60% total. Founder eligibility depends on actual R&D/payroll, not ownership.; matching: <=50% grant; self funds ordinarily below capital or financial plan.; office rent: Not in the listed eligible categories.; reporting: Dedicated account/ledger, paid original vouchers in project dates; all participating-person data consents; project results and follow-up. Midterm/final work and accounting reports, mandatory accountant certification for final claim; audit fee self-funded, cannot be project cost. Three-year outcome tracking. Weekly work records may be required to remedy delayed progress.; subscriptions API: Technology/IP acquisition includes software/database; recurring SaaS/API eligibility not explicitly resolved.; travel flights: No general travel category in this programme accounting schedule.
Requirements: duration: Six to twelve months; approved extension at most two months. Form preset2026-08-01 start is template, contract approval governs.; submission: Three paper copies plus electronic Word/PDF and attachments, postal/hand-delivery AND Google Form upload followed by telephone receipt confirmation.; video: No initial mandatory video found.

tw-sbir-1.activities:
Expense rules: IP: Research outcomes and IP belong to applicant. Government retains free, nontransferable, nonexclusive research use for national/public interests. Mainland implementation is subject to applicable Taiwan investment/technology-cooperation/trade laws.; clawbacks: Unspent funds and interest returned; ineligible costs/missed outputs can reduce award. False claims can trigger recovery and five-year exclusion.; computers equipment: Approved research equipment and software usage/depreciation prorated to project. Purchase price is not automatically reimbursable in full.; founder salary: Company responsible person doing project R&D must be included as R&D personnel; actual payroll, approved person-months and time allocation required. Standard personnel allocation normally <=60%, explain excess. No dividends or arbitrary founder draw.; matching: Subsidy <=50%; self-funding generally should not exceed paid capital unless credible financial plan supplied.; office rent: No ordinary office rent line established. Office consumables excluded.; other: Patent-application budget exists subject to qualified project-generated patent evidence and accounting caps; include it explicitly rather than assume excluded.; reimbursement reporting: Dedicated accounting, original invoices, payroll/timesheets and progress checks. Semiannual review; Phase 1 PI work record, Phase 2 all R&D staff work records. <=9-month project normally two instalments; longer project final15% holdback. Full advance may require equal bank guarantee. Three-year outcome tracking. Without full guarantee, subsequent instalment requires approved work/accounting reports and cumulative expenditure at least75%.; subscriptions API: Software is recognized in research equipment accounting; ordinary SaaS/API subscriptions are not expressly resolved in the reviewed text. Obtain classification before budgeting.; travel flights: Necessary domestic R&D/field-validation travel including documented flights; overseas travel not listed as eligible.
Requirements: stage: Concept/feasibility validation, maximum six months.; submission: Online portal; Phase 1 presentation, Phase 2 written plan and evidence. Login-only live portal fields not exhaustively visible.; video: No mandatory application video found.

Expense rules: IP: Research outcomes and IP belong to applicant. Government retains free, nontransferable, nonexclusive research use for national/public interests. Mainland implementation is subject to applicable Taiwan investment/technology-cooperation/trade laws.; clawbacks: Unspent funds and interest returned; ineligible costs/missed outputs can reduce award. False claims can trigger recovery and five-year exclusion.; computers equipment: Approved research equipment and software usage/depreciation prorated to project. Purchase price is not automatically reimbursable in full.; founder salary: Company responsible person doing project R&D must be included as R&D personnel; actual payroll, approved person-months and time allocation required. Standard personnel allocation normally <=60%, explain excess. No dividends or arbitrary founder draw.; matching: Subsidy <=50%; self-funding generally should not exceed paid capital unless credible financial plan supplied.; office rent: No ordinary office rent line established. Office consumables excluded.; other: Patent-application budget exists subject to qualified project-generated patent evidence and accounting caps; include it explicitly rather than assume excluded.; reimbursement reporting: Dedicated accounting, original invoices, payroll/timesheets and progress checks. Semiannual review; Phase 1 PI work record, Phase 2 all R&D staff work records. <=9-month project normally two instalments; longer project final15% holdback. Full advance may require equal bank guarantee. Three-year outcome tracking. Without full guarantee, subsequent instalment requires approved work/accounting reports and cumulative expenditure at least75%.; subscriptions API: Software is recognized in research equipment accounting; ordinary SaaS/API subscriptions are not expressly resolved in the reviewed text. Obtain classification before budgeting.; travel flights: Necessary domestic R&D/field-validation travel including documented flights; overseas travel not listed as eligible.
Requirements: stage: R&D after demonstrated feasibility, prototypes and market/pilot verification; previous Phase 1 is not universally mandatory. One or two years.; submission: Online portal; Phase 1 presentation, Phase 2 written plan and evidence. Login-only live portal fields not exhaustively visible.; video: No mandatory application video found.

tw-taichung-local-sbir.activities:
Expense rules: Applicant finances the remainder and may need cash flow before reimbursement. Dedicated bank account, original vouchers and return of interest/unspent funds. R&D payroll generally <=60% of total budget; future hires <=30% of research person-months. R&D materials, equipment/software use and maintenance, technology/contract research and patent costs can qualify; generic equipment purchase is not automatically eligible. Reporting lateness incurs daily 0.1% of subsidy penalty.
Requirements: Single-company route. Joint route requires two companies, not two people. Small firms below five employees have an insurance-evidence alternative; no numeric R&D personnel minimum verified. New innovative R&D, with accountable milestones. No mandatory application video or pre-existing MVP rule identified.
tw-taichung-local-sbir.purpose: 2026 intake closed; next cycle unannounced. Individual R&D grant up to TWD 1,000,000 with at least matching applicant finance. Domestic SME registered in Taichung; funded work must take place in Taichung. Civilian AI, ICT/security software and innovative service systems are eligible themes. Worth considering for new R&D if the company and execution location qualify; existing completed software alone does not establish a fundable project.

requirements.details: Company count: 1; evidence: Single-company route; no numerical R&D staff minimum identified. Applicant must document formal project staffing; no owner qualification inferred.
requirements.label: Team

requirements.details: Domestic SME registered in Taichung; funded work must take place in Taichung.; SME paid capital up to TWD100m OR fewer than 200 employees. Branches and PRC-invested applicants excluded. Duplicate government funding, arrears and serious violations disqualify. Consecutive awards in 2024 and 2025 exclude a new 2026 award. us-nia-startup-challenge-2027.activities:
Expense rules: IP: Publication permission for submission; ownership transfer not stated. No confidential/proprietary materials.; federal funds: Federal grants/cooperative funds only where consistent with original award, with entry on behalf of awardee entity; prize becomes program income. Federal contract funds prohibited for submission/support.; flights: Travel-related expenses permitted in principle; flights are not separately enumerated.; matching: No matching requirement stated.; notes: Stage 1 supports early business/product development. Stage 2 impact examples include team expansion, pilot data, customers and fundraising, but examples are not itemized allowable-cost guarantees.; reporting: Stage 2 deliverables and mentor assessment; separate financial reporting not published.; travel: A portion of Stage 1 cash may explicitly support in-person attendance travel.
Requirements: Science-driven aging/older-adult innovation including dementia, healthy aging, care delivery and caregiver burden; AI explicitly of interest. No initial mandatory MVP, customers or revenue threshold stated.; Multiple submissions allowed, but only one finalist selection per individual/team/entity. Avoid all confidential/proprietary content: submission licenses NIH publication of all or parts.; Training develops a 2-minute elevator pitch and 7-minute presentation. Stage 2 scoring: mentor/impact statement 45 points, video 55 points.
